lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Write the fact family for 8, 5 and 13.

FEEDBACK
8+5=13; 5+8=13; 13−8=5; 13−5=8.

WATCH FOR
Treating subtraction as unrelated to addition makes missing facts harder to rebuild.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Build eight fact families (numbers within 20). For four of them write a word sentence using "difference" or "how many left".

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: Build eight fact families (numbers within 20). For four of them write a word sentence using "difference" or "how many left". Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Original response on new material: 8+5=13; 5+8=13; 13−8=5; 13−5=8. Reasoning: I used subtraction by attending to add back and explain why it matters rather than copying the worked model.

Parent: Written model 2: Common error: Treating subtraction as unrelated to addition makes missing facts harder to rebuild. Correction: 8+5=13; 5+8=13; 13−8=5; 13−5=8. Why: the correction restores accurate use of subtraction.

Parent: Likely misconception: Treating subtraction as unrelated to addition makes missing facts harder to rebuild. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

teach_steps.explain:
Subtraction facts link to addition: if 8+7=15, then 15−8=7 and 15−7=8. Difference asks how many more or left.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
